healthcare.heading: Patient access and clinical operations on one connected platform.
healthcare.summary: For hospitals, clinic networks and diagnostic providers: digitise how patients reach you, how work moves internally, and how your systems share data — without disrupting care delivery.
healthcare.challengesTitle: The bottlenecks providers describe to us
healthcare.challengesSummary: Six patterns we see repeatedly in provider operations. Each one is solvable with technology you can run without a research team.
healthcare.ch1Desc: Booking, rescheduling and document requests still arrive by phone and messaging apps, so front-desk staff absorb the load and patients wait.
healthcare.ch2Title: Scheduling rules live in people's heads
healthcare.ch2Desc: Capacity depends on room, equipment and specialist availability, but the rules sit in spreadsheets and local habit rather than the system.
healthcare.ch3Title: Internal requests have no visible owner
healthcare.ch3Desc: Referrals, approvals and administrative requests move between departments with no timestamped trail, so escalation happens by chasing.
healthcare.ch4Desc: Clinical, administrative and finance systems each hold part of the truth, so management reporting is rebuilt manually every month.
healthcare.ch5Desc: Broad system permissions make audits difficult and make it risky to give partners or corporate clients any self-service at all.
healthcare.ch6Desc: Referrals, insurance paperwork and lab documents are re-keyed by staff who should be handling patients.
healthcare.solutionsSummary: Connected platforms and tailored solutions that turn provider operations into a system your teams can run and your patients can trust.
healthcare.sol1Desc: Booking, rescheduling and document requests in one portal with capacity rules and reminders, so front-desk load drops and patients get answers faster.
healthcare.sol2Desc: Scheduling rules configured per service, resource and location, with clash detection and automated reminders that replace spreadsheets and local habit.
healthcare.sol3Desc: Referrals, approvals and administrative requests on a routed workflow with SLA timers, ownership and a full audit trail.
healthcare.sol4Desc: Extraction of referrals, insurance paperwork and lab documents with confidence thresholds and a reviewer queue, integrated to your admin systems.
healthcare.sol5Desc: Role-based access with full audit trail, so partners and corporate clients get controlled self-service without broad system permissions.
healthcare.sol6Desc: One reconciled dataset across clinical, administrative and finance systems, so management reports run on current numbers without manual rebuilds.
healthcare.capabilitiesSummary: The engineering and delivery capabilities we apply to build, integrate and operate healthcare platforms your teams can rely on.
healthcare.cap1Desc: Portals, staff workspaces and mobile access built for shift-based, high-interruption use.
healthcare.cap2Desc: APIs, events and batch reconciliation between clinical, administrative and finance systems.
healthcare.cap3Desc: Document extraction pipelines with confidence thresholds and reviewer workflows.
healthcare.cap4Desc: Functional, integration and performance testing before anything touches live operations.
healthcare.cap5Desc: Environment separation, release pipelines and monitoring appropriate to sensitive workloads.
healthcare.cap6Desc: L1–L3 support with agreed service windows for systems in daily clinical use.
healthcare.ctaDesc: Bring the process that hurts most — booking, referrals, approvals or reporting. We map it, show what a first release looks like, and tell you honestly what is not worth building.

logistics.heading: Visibility and execution across the supply chain.
logistics.summary: For freight forwarders, 3PLs, warehouse operators and distribution networks: connect orders, shipments, warehouses and last-mile delivery into one operating picture your teams can act on.
logistics.challengesTitle: The bottlenecks operators describe to us
logistics.challengesSummary: Six patterns we see repeatedly in logistics and supply chain operations. Each one is solvable with technology you can run without a research team.
logistics.ch1Desc: Cargo moves between carriers, warehouses and last-mile partners, but status updates arrive late or not at all, so customer service answers questions by chasing emails.
logistics.ch2Desc: Bin locations, stock counts and pick waves are tracked manually, so picking errors and stockouts surface only at month-end reconciliation.
logistics.ch3Desc: Sales channels, the warehouse system and the finance ledger each hold a different view of stock, so promises to customers are made on data nobody trusts.
logistics.ch4Desc: Drivers are dispatched by phone and chat apps, with no live map of routes, proof of delivery or exception handling the operations team can see.
logistics.ch5Title: Customs and compliance documents are re-keyed
logistics.ch5Desc: Bill of lading, packing lists and customs declarations are typed into multiple portals by hand, so documentation errors cause delays at the border.
logistics.ch6Title: Margins are calculated after the fact
logistics.ch6Desc: Cost per shipment, per lane and per customer is reconstructed from spreadsheets weeks later, so pricing decisions rely on stale numbers.
logistics.solutionsSummary: Connected platforms and tailored solutions that turn logistics operations into a system your teams can run and your customers can trust.
logistics.sol1Desc: A unified view of every shipment across carriers and partners, with status events, exceptions and proactive alerts routed to the right team.
logistics.sol2Desc: Bin-level inventory, wave picking and cycle counting on mobile devices, with real-time stock updates that feed sales channels and finance.
logistics.sol3Desc: One reconciled dataset across channels, warehouse and ledger, so available-to-promise is accurate and reporting no longer needs manual rebuilds.
logistics.sol4Desc: Route planning, driver mobile app, live map and electronic proof of delivery, with exception workflows for failed attempts and redeliveries.
logistics.sol5Desc: Extraction of bill of lading, packing list and customs data with confidence thresholds and a reviewer queue, integrated to your compliance portals.
logistics.sol6Desc: Per-shipment, per-lane and per-customer cost attribution from operational data, so pricing and lane decisions run on current numbers.
logistics.capabilitiesSummary: The engineering and delivery capabilities we apply to build, integrate and operate logistics platforms your teams can rely on.
logistics.cap1Desc: Operations consoles, driver apps and customer portals built for shift-based, high-volume use.
logistics.cap2Desc: APIs, events and batch reconciliation between WMS, TMS, ERP, carrier and marketplace systems.
logistics.cap3Desc: Document extraction, demand forecasting and anomaly detection with human review built in.
logistics.cap4Desc: Functional, integration and performance testing before anything touches live operations.
logistics.cap5Desc: Environment separation, release pipelines and monitoring for 24/7 operational workloads.
logistics.cap6Desc: L1–L3 support with agreed service windows for systems in daily operational use.
logistics.ctaEyebrow: Move from spreadsheets to a system
logistics.ctaDesc: Book a focused walkthrough with a senior MeU logistics specialist. You see the platform against your lanes, your warehouses and your customers, not a generic pitch.

retail.heading: Omnichannel commerce, connected end to end.
retail.summary: For retailers, marketplaces and D2C brands: connect online and offline selling, POS, inventory and fulfillment into one commerce operation that scales with your customers.
retail.challengesTitle: The bottlenecks retailers describe to us
retail.challengesSummary: Six patterns we see repeatedly in retail and commerce operations. Each one is solvable with technology you can run without a research team.
retail.ch1Title: Online and offline sell from different stock
retail.ch1Desc: The web store, the POS and the warehouse each hold their own view of inventory, so overselling and stockouts surface only when a customer complains.
retail.ch2Desc: In-store sales, online orders and returns move through separate systems, so a single customer journey cannot be seen or served end to end.
retail.ch3Title: Fulfillment is stitched together by hand
retail.ch3Desc: Picking, packing and shipping are coordinated across spreadsheets and chat, so peak-season volume breaks the process and errors rise.
retail.ch4Desc: Catalog data, images and attributes are maintained in multiple tools, so listings drift across channels and merchandising is slow.
retail.ch5Title: Promotions and pricing are hard to change
retail.ch5Desc: Price changes and promotions require developer intervention or manual updates per channel, so commercial teams cannot move at market speed.
retail.ch6Desc: Purchase history, loyalty and service interactions sit in different systems, so personalization and retention run on incomplete pictures.
retail.solutionsSummary: Commerce platforms and tailored solutions that turn retail operations into one connected system your teams can run and your customers can trust.
retail.sol1Desc: One real-time stock view across web, store and warehouse, with available-to-promise that prevents overselling and powers buy-online-pickup-in-store.
retail.sol2Desc: POS, online orders, returns and exchanges on one order service, so a customer journey is consistent regardless of where it starts or ends.
retail.sol3Desc: Pick, pack and ship workflows with mobile devices, wave planning and carrier integration built for peak-season volume.
retail.sol4Desc: A single source of truth for catalog data, images and attributes, syndicated to every sales channel without manual re-entry.
retail.sol5Desc: Rules-based pricing and promotions that commercial teams can configure themselves, applied consistently across every channel.
retail.sol6Desc: A unified customer profile across purchases, loyalty and service, so personalization and retention run on the full picture.
retail.capabilitiesSummary: The engineering and delivery capabilities we apply to build, integrate and operate commerce platforms your teams can rely on.
retail.cap1Desc: Storefronts, POS, admin consoles and mobile apps built for high-volume, peak-season use.
retail.cap2Desc: APIs, events and batch reconciliation between ecommerce, POS, ERP, payment and carrier systems.
retail.cap3Desc: Recommendations, demand forecasting and search relevance with human control built in.
retail.cap4Desc: Functional, integration and load testing that proves the platform holds under peak-season traffic.
retail.cap5Desc: Elastic infrastructure, release pipelines and monitoring that scale with seasonal demand.
retail.cap6Desc: L1–L3 support with agreed service windows for commerce systems in daily customer use.

pharma.sol4Desc: GxP and SOP training records, assignments and renewals in one system, so audit readiness is a report rather than a project.
